label: Corsair Vengeance i7400 gaming PC
description: Prebuilt ATX gaming tower (i9-13900K / RTX 4080 on the review SKU) built on an MSI PRO Z690-A DDR5 board.
notes: 2.5GbE RJ45 from the Realtek RTL8125 on the PRO Z690-A DDR5 board (non-WIFI SKU, so no wlan0). Corsair's own port list confirms a single rear Ethernet jack - this node must be cabled to join the lab.
